plan.thoughts: Sunday has two fixed Seahawks games at the Vault. I gave each game to the people who actually like watching sports and saved the beer-only fans for two separate Lumber House pints groups, one afternoon and one evening, each made of people of a similar age. Trail people are split three ways so the keenest hikers aren't stacked together: a hike-and-photo group at the Gorge with two fishers, a history-focused Franklin walk, and a picnic hike at Flaming Geyser. Pickleball runs morning and evening as doubles foursomes, and the evening session ends early for those who avoid late nights. Older card players get cribbage at the bakery, and older crafters get a garage workshop afternoon. I checked what everyone avoids against the times: nothing runs late, and no early mornings go to anyone who avoids them.

Each neighbor has told their own agent what they like, what they don't, and when they're free. You talk to each person's agent one to one. Agents never talk to each other. - Each person in at most one group. Use only people in that break room.
